note: Full installed catalogue for the two-sided recall/cost router benchmark. token_cost is a DECOY estimate (all 1); reported cost must be a whitespace count of the concatenated injected descriptions, measured per task after injection. usage_count is telemetry only.

capabilities.description: Inspect the git working-tree dirty bit, list untracked files, and report whether the index matches HEAD for the current repository checkout.
Scan a payload for leaked credentials, planted tokens, and refuse to print live API keys when the detector fires on a receipt or log fragment.
Require a nonempty source_probe and a mechanically different verifier_probe before a CONFIRMED or REFUTED verdict; reject same-probe-rerun as a schema-invalid confirmation record.
Walk a capability root that contains a reserved-device file named NUL and compare the crawler count against an independent Get-ChildItem census for parity.
When a fixture path hits MAX_PATH overflow at two-hundred-sixty characters, emit the extended-length prefix form rather than truncating the leaf.
Lint Markdown files for heading-order inversions and require a language tag on every fenced-code block before the document is accepted.
Diff the repository skill copy against the live skills directory and list entries present in the repo that are missing from the live tree, including frontmatter always-on versus lazy-load flags.
No installed capability matches the task; return the declared fallback rather than a confident wrong pick from the catalogue.
